data.title: DIGITAL GRID Accelerates Battery Investments as Renewable Platform Surges
data.description:
DIGITAL GRID Corporation ( (JP:350A) ) has shared an announcement.

DIGITAL GRID reported strong growth in its Renewable Energy Platform business for the year ended July 31, 2026, driven by rising transactions on its RE Bridge platform and more than 60% year-on-year expansion in its Econohashi non-fossil certificate service. Total contracted capacity across its platforms reached a record 1.4 gigawatts, while registered capacity on RE Bridge hit 2 gigawatts and total renewable energy capacity climbed to 393 megawatts.

The company is rapidly scaling its grid-scale battery Aggregation Service, launching low-voltage aggregation to meet investor demand for faster deployment and concentrating on contracted capacity as its core performance metric. DIGITAL GRID has already allocated nearly all of its three-year, ¥10 billion battery investment plan in the first year, expects AS business sales to quadruple in fiscal 2027, and sees Middle East-driven power market volatility as broadly neutral for its power platform but a net positive for renewables and future battery revenue opportunities.

Revisions to the medium-term plan include lowering the operating margin target to above 30% due to higher depreciation from battery investments, while maintaining a 40% adjusted EBITDA margin goal and reiterating that profitability expectations remain high. All major financial and operational targets for fiscal 2026, such as ROE above 20%, operating margin, contracted capacity, and battery investment execution, were achieved or exceeded ahead of schedule, underscoring the company’s execution strength and competitive edge in site development and platform synergies.

More about DIGITAL GRID Corporation

DIGITAL GRID Corporation operates in the renewable energy and power platform industry, providing services that match renewable generators with buyers and aggregate grid-scale batteries for market participation. Its key offerings include the RE Bridge renewable energy matching platform, Econohashi non-fossil certificate procurement service, and aggregation services for low- and high-voltage grid-scale batteries, with a growing focus on contracted capacity across consumers, generators, and storage assets.

The company targets high profitability through a platform- and asset-light model complemented by strategic investment in grid-scale batteries. It operates primarily in Japan’s evolving electricity market, where post-FIT reforms require generators to secure purchasers and manage supply-demand balancing, positioning DIGITAL GRID as a facilitator of market access and optimization for renewable energy and battery investors.
